key_insight: The paper finds that the main bottleneck in object-goal navigation is not exploration, but goal grounding: fine-tuned vision-language navigation policies often fail to recognize when the target object is already visible or how close it is. StopWatch is designed to fix this missing perception-and-localization ability.
problem_solved: It addresses low success rates in object-goal navigation by diagnosing and improving the ability of pretrained VLM-based navigation agents to ground the target object in the current scene.
method: Diagnose failure modes of fine-tuned VLM navigation policies and identify goal grounding as the dominant weakness.
Introduce a method, StopWatch, that helps the agent detect when the goal object is already in view and estimate its relative distance.
Use this grounding signal to improve decision-making during navigation, reducing unnecessary exploration and missed goal detections.
impact: For practitioners, this paper shows that better navigation performance may come less from more exploration and more from stronger goal perception. It offers a clear direction for improving embodied AI systems by adding explicit grounding capabilities to VLM-based policies.

paper_title: StopWatch: Goal Grounding for Object-goal Navigation
paper_authors: Xinhao Liu, Yunsheng Tian, Yuheng Qiu, Pieter Abbeel, Xi Chen
